W1.name: Normal Workload
W1.description: Standard steady-state operational banking load within normal business capacity.

W2.name: Peak Workload
W2.description: Daily peak banking traffic (e.g., lunchtime or business opening hours).

W3.name: Extreme Workload
W3.description: Stress-test volume exceeding on-premise static capacity to evaluate throttling and queuing bottlenecks.

W4.name: Burst Workload
W4.description: Sudden traffic spikes simulating salary credit days or promotional financial events.

W5.name: Failure Workload
W5.description: Workload with an unexpected server outage injected mid-run to test fault impact.

W6.name: Recovery Workload
W6.description: Fault injection followed by automated health checks, replica failover, and disaster recovery.
